messages:
sara_pm: Heads-up — Acme asked for a regional low-latency variant behind a feature flag. They want EU-only for first month, then expand if latency+quality look good. Need a rollout plan: canary %, A/B metric targets, fallback behavior, and ops playbook.

mike_ops: @sara_pm noted. Key constraints: EU capacity limited on dedicated pools this quarter. We'll need soft cap + burst policy. Also ask: do we prefer traffic steering or per-tenant flag?

jon_eng: Per-tenant flag is safer for opt-in, but for EU-only initially, routing by region + flag is simplest. Proposal: 5% of EU traffic canary for 24h, then 25% for 48h, then 100% EU.

anna_ml: Suggested success metrics: p50/p95 latency delta <= 10ms vs baseline, token-level hallucination rate delta < 1%, and nps-like sample quality pass rate > 95% on eval set. Define the eval prompt set now.

paul_sre: Ops checklist: circuit breaker at 3x error rate, automatic rollback if latency SLO violated for 30m, and capacity fallback to quantized L2 model when GPU pool hits 85% util. Need runbook entries for oncall.

jon_eng: Add a staged A/B to measure cost delta. A sidecar will route 10% of A traffic to cheaper model but mirror outputs for quality comparison. If mirror divergence > 2% after 48h, stop.

sara_pm: Can we capture these in feature-flag config? Draft flag schema for ops to review: 
```yaml
flag: acme_eu_low_latency_variant
enabled_for: ["acme_corp"]
region_filter: "eu"
canary_steps:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 24h
  - pct: 25
    duration: 48h
  - pct: 100
    duration: 7d
fallback_policy:
  - condition: "errors > baseline * 3 or p95_latency > baseline + 50ms"
    action: rollback
  - condition: "gpu_pool_util >= 85%"
    action: "route_to_quantized_model"
metrics_reporting: ["latency_p50","latency_p95","error_rate","quality_pass_rate"]
```

mike_ops: This looks good. Two additions: (1) add a kill-switch tag that Ops can flip without deploy, and (2) require preflight shadow run for 12h to populate caches.

paul_sre: +1 to kill-switch. Also add an automatic alert to #eng-oncall and paging policy if circuit breaker fires.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary run scheduled by sara_pm at 2024-11-01T08:00Z. Canary ID: cb-1743211111-01.

jon_eng: We'll implement the routing and mirror pipeline. ETA for PR: 2 days. I'll add telemetry hooks for per-tenant breakdowns.

anna_ml: I'll assemble the eval prompt set and run a dry eval on mirrored outputs; share results in this thread.

sara_pm: Great — owners: jon (engineering), mike (ops), anna (quality), paul (oncall). Next steps: jon to open PR with flag + routing; mike to confirm capacity reservation for the canary window; anna to post eval set by EOD. We'll reconvene after the preflight. :thumbsup:
